{"status":"Completed","reason":"Current-run upstream implementation and validation artifacts were readable, and the handoff packet was written to the primary managed ref with a durable summary of the accepted TetrisGame slice. The feature change set shows the home-route Tetris surface, navigation simplification, and Counter route adjustment; targeted validation confirms restore/build/test all passed for the grounded solution and xUnit project.","branchOutcomeKey":"none","branchOutcomeTitle":"No branch outcome","evidenceRefs":["artifacts/process-runs/fef178ba-8721-4550-aab5-f971523957cd/steps/code-change.md","artifacts/process-runs/fef178ba-8721-4550-aab5-f971523957cd/steps/targeted-validation.md","artifacts/process-runs/fef178ba-8721-4550-aab5-f971523957cd/steps/feature-handoff.md"],"nextActions":["Continue the parent process with downstream runtime/browser proof if required.","Treat the slice as accepted for handoff; only escalate if later browser proof or broader product-scope validation fails."],"humanReadableSummaryMarkdown":"## Completed
The handoff packet is written and the current run has enough evidence to summarize the feature path.

### What changed
- Home route now renders the first reviewable TetrisGame surface.
- Navigation was reduced to the relevant Play entry.
- The stock Counter route was neutralized for this slice.

### What passed
- Restore succeeded on the grounded solution target.
- Build succeeded on the grounded solution target.
- xUnit test execution succeeded on the grounded test project.

### Residual risk
- The implementation is intentionally minimal and does not yet cover full Tetris rules, scoring, or persistence.
- Browser-visible proof remains downstream to the broader process.

### Parent recommendation
Continue the parent process; the feature slice is accepted and ready for downstream proof or remaining scope work."}
